text.content: This chapter provides pre-designed templates for common species and character archetypes found in the Shadows of The Mandalorian War campaign. Templates offer a quick way to create characters by providing a foundation of attributes, advantages, disadvantages, and skills. They are starting points, and players are encouraged to customize them with remaining Character Points (CP) to truly make the character their own.

Each template is a package of traits (attributes, advantages, disadvantages, and skills) designed to represent a typical member of a species or a common character role.

  • Total CP: The overall point value of the template.
  • Attributes: Base attribute scores (ST, DX, IQ, HT).
  • Secondary Characteristics: Derived values (HP, EP, Basic Speed, Basic Move, FP).
  • Advantages: A list of advantages with their point costs.
  • Disadvantages: A list of disadvantages with their point values (these add CP back to the template).
  • Skills: A list of skills with their base levels and CP costs.
  • Starting Equipment: Suggested starting gear and wealth.
  • Roleplaying Hooks: Brief notes on typical motivations, background, or societal roles.

These templates represent the inherent biological and cultural traits of various species, forming the foundation for any character of that lineage. These advantages, disadvantages, quirks, and perks all cost 0 CP for these species as they are indicative of core biological traits of the species.

Attribute Modifiers: Attribute modifiers work the same way and are equally free: a racial +2 to IQ or -2 to ST costs and refunds nothing. What it does is move where that attribute starts. The racially adjusted score is the character's own baseline, and points are spent only to buy above it or recovered only by going below it -- an Arkanian's free IQ 12 is the 0-point mark from which they buy 13, 14, 15, and a Wookiee's free IQ 8 is the 0-point mark from which they buy 9. This is why no species costs more or less than another to be: you never pay for what your species is, only for what you did with it.

Secondary Characteristics: A species' Attributes line covers secondary characteristics on the same terms: a racial Will or Perception modifier is free and moves that baseline exactly as an IQ modifier does.

Granted Rows: A granted row is not a baseline, and does not behave like one. An attribute modifier moves a scale you then buy along in either direction; a granted advantage, disadvantage, quirk or skill row -- a free native tongue, a racial Damage Resistance, a species skill -- is a thing you have at zero points, and lowering or dropping it recovers nothing. The reason is the same sentence above: if giving a species more free rows made its members richer in CP, that species would cost less to be, and no species costs more or less than another to be. Sell back a Wookiee's free comprehension of Basic and you have not spent a smaller number of points -- you have described a Wookiee who does not exist.

Droids: Droids are not a species: a droid character is built from a chassis template in @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.1ZEtj9W2Z8w75PYC]{Chapter 17} and pays for it out of the campaign's starting points.

Arkanian

  • Height: 1.80 m / 5'11" -- SM -0.04
  • Weight: 71 kg / 158 lb
  • Attributes: IQ +2; DX +1.
  • Advantages: Mathematical Ability; Charisma 1.
  • Disadvantages: Overconfidence; Curious; Truthfulness; Distinctive Features (White Eyes).
  • Features: Near-Humans known for their pale skin, white hair, and four-fingered hands. Masters of genetic manipulation and advanced technology, often perceived as arrogant but brilliant.

Bothan

  • Height: 1.45 m / 4'9" -- SM -0.60
  • Weight: 38 kg / 83 lb
  • Attributes: IQ +1; ST -1.
  • Advantages: Contacts (Bothan Spynet; Skill-15; Usually Reliable); Charisma 1; Language Talent.
  • Disadvantages: Reputation -2 (As manipulative spies; All non-Bothans; All the time); Paranoia; Secret (Involved in Espionage).
  • Features: A species of furry humanoids renowned across the galaxy for their mastery of espionage and information brokering. Bothan society is built on the acquisition and leveraging of secrets, making them invaluable allies and treacherous enemies.

Cathar

  • Height: 1.70 m / 5'7" -- SM -0.19
  • Weight: 75 kg / 166 lb
  • Attributes: ST +1; DX +1; IQ -1.
  • Advantages: Perfect Balance; Fearlessness 1; Fit.
  • Disadvantages: Bad Temper; Impulsiveness; Social Stigma (Refugee); Distinctive Features (Feline Appearance).
  • Features: Feline humanoids, known for their martial prowess and loyalty. Their homeworld, Cathar, was devastated during the Mandalorian Wars, making them common refugees or fierce combatants.

Chiss

  • Height: 1.80 m / 5'11" -- SM -0.04
  • Weight: 71 kg / 158 lb
  • Attributes: IQ +1.
  • Advantages: Infravision; Composed.
  • Disadvantages: Code of Honor (Chiss Non-Aggression Directive); Secret (Involved with Chiss Ascendancy interests).
  • Features: Highly sophisticated near-Humans from Csilla with blue skin, jet-black hair, and glowing red eyes that register heat signatures. Their culture prioritizes cold logic, strategic patience, and an absolute adherence to their strict directive against launching preemptive military strikes.

Dowutin

  • Height: 3.00 m / 9'10" -- SM +1.29
  • Weight: 496 kg / 1093 lb
  • Attributes: ST +4; IQ -1; HT +1.
  • Advantages: Damage Resistance 1 (Thick Hide); Acute Senses (Hearing) 2; Temperature Tolerance 2 (Cold).
  • Disadvantages: Appearance (Unattractive); Bad Temper; Social Stigma (Valuable Property – often viewed as beasts of burden).
  • Features: Large, hulking humanoids with thick, durable skin and small horns. Dowutins are long-lived, slow-aging, and renowned for their incredible physical strength and endurance. They are often employed in heavy labor or as security, though they are notoriously quick to anger if provoked.

Echani

  • Height: 1.70 m / 5'7" -- SM -0.19
  • Weight: 60 kg / 133 lb
  • Attributes: DX +2; HT +1.
  • Advantages: Perfect Balance; Echani Reflexes 1; Fit; Fearlessness 1; Combat Aptitude; Read Opponent.
  • Disadvantages: Overconfidence (Martial); Obsession (Perfection).
  • Features: A near-Human species renowned for their martial prowess. Echani culture values combat as a form of communication, allowing them to read an opponent’s intentions and history through their fighting style. Their disciplined training and innate grace make them exceptionally difficult to hit.

Gand

  • Height: 1.50 m / 4'11" -- SM -0.52
  • Weight: 41 kg / 91 lb
  • Attributes: HT +1; Perception +1.
  • Advantages: Damage Resistance 2 (Exoskeleton); Less Sleep 2; Infravision.
  • Disadvantages: Dependency (Ammonia atmosphere; must wear a breather mask in oxygen-rich environments); Odious Personal Habits (Refers to self in third person until earning a name).
  • Features: Resilient, insectoid bipeds with a rugged exoskeleton. The mystical “Findsman” tradition is highly respected among their kind, making them peerless trackers and bounty hunters. While many rely on external breather masks when traveling off-world, integrating permanent internal breathers would require mandatory surgical installation, as is the case for all cybernetics and implants.

Human

  • Height: 1.83 m / 6'0" -- SM 0
  • Weight: 75 kg / 165 lb
  • Attributes: No Modifiers.
  • Advantages: None inherent.
  • Disadvantages: None inherent.
  • Features: Adaptable, found in all walks of life. The most common species within both Republic and Mandalorian ranks.
  • Customization Note: Versatility (@UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.2I6Edey1uD2bgyES]{Chapter 4}): Humans gain 20 bonus Character Points to spend on anything — attributes, secondary characteristics, skills, or advantages.

Ithorian

  • Height: 2.00 m / 6'7" -- SM +0.23
  • Weight: 122 kg / 269 lb
  • Attributes: IQ +1; Will +1; DX -1.
  • Advantages: Empathy (Plant); Innate Attack (Sonic Bellow; 2d cr, cone); Longevity.
  • Disadvantages: Pacifism (Self-Defense Only); Vow (Preserve Nature).
  • Features: “Hammerheads” with curved, stereoscopic necks and dual mouths. Their unique vocal biology allows them to produce a devastating concussive sonic wave when threatened. Deeply spiritual and ecologically minded, they revere the natural balance and are highly sought after for planetary restoration projects, such as the effort on Telos IV.
  • Recommended Language: Ithorese (Native) [0]. Basic is bought like any language (typically Fluent [3]); the dual-mouth resonance is permanent flavour on any Basic an Ithorian speaks, never a penalty. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Jawa

  • Height: 1.00 m / 3'3" -- SM -1.57
  • Weight: 12 kg / 27 lb
  • Attributes: ST -2; DX +1; IQ +1.
  • Advantages: Night Vision 5; Resistant (Disease, +3); High Manual Dexterity.
  • Disadvantages: Social Stigma (Scavenger); Appearance (Unattractive); Quirk (Obsessive about trading/tech).
  • Features: Short, rodent-like humanoids covered in dark robes. They are masters of trade and desert scavenging, possessing an uncanny ability to repair almost any piece of technological salvage. They are highly communal and rarely seen outside their sandcrawlers.
  • Recommended Language: Jawaese (Native) [0], plus the Jawa Trade Language for outsiders, a normal bought language (@UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}). Basic is bought if at all -- rare among Jawa and reserved for outsider dealings, Broken [1] where most who bother stop. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Miraluka

  • Height: 1.80 m / 5'11" -- SM -0.04
  • Weight: 71 kg / 158 lb
  • Attributes: Perception +1.
  • Advantages: Danger Sense; Field Detection; Force Sensitive (Racial Trait); Force Sight (Miraluka Specialized Vision); Force Power: Miralukan Force Sight (Sense Power) - Level 1 Apprentice.
  • Disadvantages: Blind (Non-Conventional).
  • Features: Appear human but lack eyes; perceive the world through the Force. Highly sensitive to Force disturbances, making them potentially crucial in an era where the Force’s balance is shifting.

Mirialan

  • Height: 1.75 m / 5'9" -- SM -0.11
  • Weight: 66 kg / 145 lb
  • Attributes: IQ +1.
  • Advantages: Common Sense; Fit; Cultural Adaptability.
  • Disadvantages: Vow (Ritual Observance); Sense of Duty (Their People); Truthfulness; Distinctive Features (Tattoos).
  • Features: Green or yellow-skinned, often with geometric facial tattoos indicating achievements or spiritual beliefs. Known for calm, logical demeanor and affinity for the Force.

Nautolan

  • Height: 1.80 m / 5'11" -- SM -0.04
  • Weight: 71 kg / 158 lb
  • Attributes: HT +1.
  • Advantages: Amphibious; Doesn’t Breathe (Gills); Peripheral Vision; Empathy (Scent/Pheromone-based, operational primarily in moist environments).
  • Disadvantages: Dependency (Water, must immerse daily or suffer fatigue); Appearance (Unattractive to standard humanoids due to large black eyes).
  • Features: Amphibious bipeds from Glee Anselm with crown-like tendrils that can detect emotional changes and pheromone signatures in others. They are exceptionally well-suited for underwater tracking and combat, maintaining peak physical vitality in sub-aquatic conditions.

Quarren

  • Height: 1.80 m / 5'11" -- SM -0.04
  • Weight: 71 kg / 158 lb
  • Attributes: HT +1.
  • Advantages: Amphibious; Doesn’t Breathe (Gills); Damage Resistance 1 (Leathery Skin).
  • Disadvantages: Bad Temper; Intolerance (Surface Dwellers); Stubbornness; Appearance (Unattractive).
  • Features: Aquatic humanoids with squid-like facial tentacles, suction-cupped fingers, and the ability to spit blinding ink in underwater combat. Sharing the oceanic world of Dac (Mon Calamari) with their idealistic neighbors, the Quarren tend to be more pragmatic, isolationist, and deeply entrenched in underworld dealings, mining, and heavy labor on worlds like Nar Shaddaa.
  • Recommended Language: Quarrenese (Native) [0]. Basic is bought like any language, ranging Broken [1] to Fluent [3] by individual. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Rakata

  • Height: 2.00 m / 6'7" -- SM +0.23
  • Weight: 122 kg / 269 lb
  • Attributes: IQ +2; Will -1.
  • Advantages: Peripheral Vision; Longevity; High Manual Dexterity.
  • Disadvantages: Social Stigma (Fallen Empire/Savage); Callous; Megalomania.
  • Features: Amphibian-like humanoids with cone-shaped heads and eyestalks. Once the architects of the Infinite Empire and creators of the Star Forge, their species was completely severed from the Force by a virulent biological plague. They cannot possess the Force Sensitive trait, and their isolated tribes on Lehon are now a primitive echo of their former glory.
  • Recommended Language: Rakatan (Native) [0]. Rakata do not grow up with Basic at all; one who speaks it bought it at the full ladder price -- a genuine barrier for the rest of the party. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Rodian

  • Height: 1.60 m / 5'3" -- SM -0.35
  • Weight: 50 kg / 110 lb
  • Attributes: DX +1.
  • Advantages: Combat Reflexes; Fit.
  • Disadvantages: Impulsiveness; Greed; Reputation -1 (Untrustworthy, to non-Rodians); Appearance (Unattractive).
  • Features: Green-skinned, insectoid appearance; known for hunting prowess and unique vocalizations. Rodians were often bounty hunters or spacers, many involved in the war.
  • Recommended Language: Rodese (Native) [0]. Basic is bought like any language (typically Accented [2]); the Rodian accent is permanent flavour, not a penalty. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Selkath

  • Height: 1.50 m / 4'11" -- SM -0.52
  • Weight: 41 kg / 91 lb
  • Attributes: No Modifiers.
  • Advantages: Amphibious; Damage Resistance 1 (Tough Skin); Sharp Claws (Venomous); Fit.
  • Disadvantages: Code of Honor (Strict Neutrality); Dependency (Water; must immerse daily or suffer fatigue).
  • Features: Sleek, amphibious humanoids from Manaan, instantly recognizable by their cephalic lobes and aquatic grace. Their venom-tipped claws are a potent biological defense, though their cultural adherence to diplomacy means they rarely use them in combat. Their monopoly on the healing fluid kolto makes them a pivotal, unyielding neutral party on the galactic stage.
  • Recommended Language: Selkath (Native) [0]. Manaan's isolation means Basic is bought at the full ladder -- most Selkath speak it Accented [2] at best, and many not at all. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Sith Pureblood

  • Height: 1.80 m / 5'11" -- SM -0.04
  • Weight: 71 kg / 158 lb
  • Attributes: ST +1; HT +1.
  • Advantages: Sharp Claws; Force Sensitive; High Pain Threshold.
  • Disadvantages: Bad Temper; Social Stigma (Sith Empire); Proud.
  • Features: Red-skinned humanoids indigenous to Korriban, characterized by their facial tentacles and bony spurs. Deeply linked to the dark side of the Force by blood, they possess a predatory, fiercely martial culture where hierarchy is determined strictly by Force capability and combat dominance.

Togruta

  • Height: 1.70 m / 5'7" -- SM -0.19
  • Weight: 60 kg / 133 lb
  • Attributes: DX +1.
  • Advantages: Peripheral Vision; 3D Spatial Sense.
  • Disadvantages: Distinctive Features (Skin patterns and montrals/lekku); Vulnerability (Lekku, x2 damage).
  • Features: A pack-oriented species from Shili, instantly recognizable by their colorful skin tones, large montrals, and three trailing lekku. Their hollow montrals allow them to sense space ultrasonically, translating to an innate spatial awareness that makes them naturally evasive and exceptional hunters.

Trandoshan

  • Height: 2.00 m / 6'7" -- SM +0.23
  • Weight: 122 kg / 269 lb
  • Attributes: ST +2; HT +1; IQ -1.
  • Advantages: Rapid Healing; Fit; High Pain Threshold.
  • Disadvantages: Bloodlust; Social Stigma (Savage); Cold-Blooded; Odious Personal Habits (Hisses); Distinctive Features (Reptilian); Quirk (Collects trophies).
  • Features: Reptilian humanoids, known for their predatory nature and worship of the Scorekeeper goddess. Often allied with Mandalorians as mercenaries or bounty hunters.
  • Recommended Language: Dosh (Native) [0]. Basic is bought like any language (typically Accented [2]); the guttural edge is permanent flavour, not a penalty. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Tusken Raider (Sand Person)

  • Height: 2.00 m / 6'7" -- SM +0.23
  • Weight: 98 kg / 215 lb
  • Attributes: ST +1; HT +1.
  • Advantages: Night Vision 2; Temperature Tolerance 2; High Pain Threshold.
  • Disadvantages: Social Stigma (Barbarian); Bad Temper; Intolerance (Non-Tuskens); Vow (Always wear full protective gear).
  • Features: Fierce, nomadic desert warriors of Tatooine. They are deeply xenophobic and protective of their territory, relying on gaderffii sticks and primitive slugthrowers. They are rarely seen without their complete, face-concealing wrappings, which provide essential protection from the harsh twin suns.

Twi’lek

  • Height: 1.70 m / 5'7" -- SM -0.19
  • Weight: 48 kg / 106 lb
  • Attributes: No Modifiers.
  • Advantages: Longevity; Lekku Communication; Natural Dancer; Cultural Familiarity (Twi’lek Culture); Appearance (Attractive).
  • Disadvantages: Vulnerability (Lekku, x2 damage); Distinctive Features (Lekku).
  • Features: Prehensile head-tails (lekku) used for communication; expressive physiology. Many Twi’leks were caught in the crossfire of the war.

Ugnaught

  • Height: 1.30 m / 4'3" -- SM -0.89
  • Weight: 34 kg / 74 lb
  • Attributes: ST -1; IQ +1; HT +1.
  • Advantages: Tinker’s Ingenuity; Temperature Tolerance 2; Resistant (Disease, +3).
  • Disadvantages: Social Stigma (Second-Class Citizen); Appearance (Unattractive); Stubbornness.
  • Features: Short, industrious humanoids with porcine facial features. Ugnaughts are renowned for their exceptional work ethic and mechanical aptitude, often filling roles as skilled technicians, laborers, and scavengers throughout the galaxy. They are known to have a long, complex oral history and a strong sense of clan loyalty.
  • Tinker’s Ingenuity: 10 bonus Character Points restricted to repair, technical, and craft skills.
  • Recommended Language: Ugnaught (Native) [0]. Basic is bought like any language, typically running Broken [1] to Accented [2]. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Weequay

  • Height: 1.65 m / 5'5" -- SM -0.27
  • Weight: 55 kg / 121 lb
  • Attributes: HT +1; Will +1.
  • Advantages: Damage Resistance 1 (Tough Skin); High Pain Threshold; Telecommunication (Smell/Taste; Racial, limited to other Weequays).
  • Disadvantages: Appearance (Unattractive); Stubbornness; Vow (Minor; adherence to the Quay religion or strict clan loyalty).
  • Features: Hailing from the harsh, arid world of Sriluur, Weequays are rugged humanoids known for their leathery, deeply wrinkled skin, which provides natural protection against physical damage and abrasive environments. They are famous for their stoicism, largely due to their biological ability to communicate complex ideas silently among their own kind using specialized pheromones. In the wider galaxy, this natural silence often makes them seem aloof, brooding, or menacing to outsiders, perfectly suiting their frequent employment as syndicate enforcers, bodyguards, and mercenaries navigating fringe territories and lawless outposts.
  • Recommended Language: Sriluurian (Native) [0] -- the Weequay inter-tribal and off-world tongue (within-clan they communicate by untranslatable pheromones). Basic is bought like any language, typically Broken [1] -- short, direct phrases; they speak it badly rather than only understanding it, so it is a normal language row, not the Comprehension-only entry Wookiees get. See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Wookiee

  • Height: 2.10 m / 6'11" -- SM +0.36
  • Weight: 142 kg / 312 lb
  • Attributes: ST +4 (Size, -3.6%); IQ -2.
  • Advantages: Damage Resistance 1 (Fur); Sharp Claws; Temperature Tolerance 1; Fit; High Pain Threshold.
  • Disadvantages: Bad Temper; Code of Honor (Wookiee); Distinctive Features (8ft tall); Quirk (Roars when angered).
  • Features: Large, hairy humanoids from Kashyyyk, renowned for strength and loyalty. Their home world was ravaged during the war, leading many to join the Republic or become displaced.
  • Recommended Language: Shyriiwook (Native) [0]. A Wookiee's vocal cords cannot produce Basic, so any Basic they know is Comprehension-only, bought at the half-ladder (Fluent comprehension [2]) -- not every Wookiee grows up with it; written Language (Basic, Comprehension-only). See @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.aHFgSZUXNODEwQd2]{Chapter 3}.

Yoda’s Species (Tridactyls)

  • Height: 0.66 m / 2'2" -- SM -2.66
  • Weight: 13 kg / 29 lb (canon override)
  • Attributes: ST -3; DX +2; IQ +3.
  • Advantages: High Manual Dexterity; Longevity 3 (max); Force Sensitive; Force Training 3 (Master).
  • Disadvantages: Appearance (Unattractive); Social Stigma (Minority); Pacifism (Self-Defense Only).
  • Features: Tiny, long-lived humanoids with large ears and three-fingered hands. Members of this mysterious species are exceptionally strong in the Force and possess great wisdom, though they are physically frail. They tend to speak in a unique, inverted syntax and are rarely seen by the general public.

Zabrak

  • Height: 1.80 m / 5'11" -- SM -0.04
  • Weight: 71 kg / 158 lb
  • Attributes: Will +1.
  • Advantages: High Pain Threshold; Fit; Unfazeable; Hardy; Natural Intimidator.
  • Disadvantages: Stubbornness; Unusual Appearance (Horns).
  • Features: Horned heads and facial tattoos; known for strong willpower, determination, and often physical prowess. Both Iridonian and Dathomirian Zabrak were present in the galaxy.

These archetypes represent common roles and career paths characters might take in the galaxy. They provide a conceptual starting point for building a character, suggesting key skills, advantages, and motivations.

Force-Users

  • Jedi Padawan: The apprentice. A novice learner with basic lightsaber skills and a few foundational Force powers, balanced by disadvantages reflecting their youth and inexperience.
  • Primary Attributes: Balanced DX and IQ.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Jedi Equipped.
  • Core Disadvantages: Duty (to Master), Code of Honor (Jedi), Inexperience (Quirk).
  • Essential Skills: Lightsaber, Meditation, Sense, one or two low-level Force powers.
  • Jedi Guardian: The warrior. A frontline combatant specializing in lightsaber mastery. They use the Force to enhance their physical abilities and control the battlefield.
  • Primary Attributes: High DX and ST.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Combat Reflexes, High Pain Threshold, Jedi Equipped.
  • Core Disadvantages: Code of Honor (Jedi), Sense of Duty (Republic).
  • Essential Skills: Lightsaber, Tactics, Leadership, Force Push/Pull, Force Speed.
  • Jedi Sentinel: The investigator. A versatile Jedi who blends combat with stealth and technical skills. They are adept at uncovering secrets and operating undercover.
  • Primary Attributes: High DX and IQ.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Danger Sense, Intuition, Jedi Equipped.
  • Core Disadvantages: Code of Honor (Jedi), Curious.
  • Essential Skills: Lightsaber, Stealth, Investigation, Computer Operation, Force Sight.
  • Jedi Consular: The sage. A diplomat and Force scholar who prioritizes understanding and wielding the Force over combat, often focusing on healing and mental influence.
  • Primary Attributes: High IQ and Will.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Will +1 (bought per @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.fZowiGenjFSpf9el]{Chapter 2}, 5 points/level), Empathy, Jedi Equipped.
  • Core Disadvantages: Code of Honor (Jedi), Pacifism.
  • Essential Skills: Diplomacy, Meditation, Psychology, Force Heal, Force Mind Trick.
  • Jedi Master: The leader. A powerful and wise figure who has achieved mastery in both combat and the Force, focused on teaching, diplomacy, and guiding the Jedi Order.
  • Primary Attributes: Very high IQ and Will.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Force Training (Master Tier), Reputation, Will +2 (bought per @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.fZowiGenjFSpf9el]{Chapter 2}, 5 points/level), Jedi Equipped.
  • Core Disadvantages: Sense of Duty (Jedi Order), Responsibility, Code of Honor (Jedi).
  • Essential Skills: High level in Lightsaber, Diplomacy, Leadership, and multiple Force powers.
  • Dark Jedi Aspirant: The novice. An individual just starting down the dark path, driven by raw emotion and a desire for power.
  • Primary Attributes: High ST or HT.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Self-Taught.
  • Core Disadvantages: Bad Temper, Impulsiveness, Overconfidence.
  • Essential Skills: Melee Weapon (any), Intimidation, a single aggressive Force power.
  • Dark Jedi: The fallen. A more experienced Force user who has fully embraced the dark side, combining combat skills with deception and manipulation.
  • Primary Attributes: Balanced combat and mental stats.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Dark Side Tainted, Lapsed Training.
  • Core Disadvantages: Selfish, Callous, Enemy (Jedi Order).
  • Essential Skills: Lightsaber, Intimidation, Deception, Force Lightning.
  • Dark Jedi Master: The cunning leader. A powerful master of the dark arts who commands influence through fear and strategy.
  • Primary Attributes: High IQ and Will.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Force Training (Master Tier), Allies (Sith Cultists), Lapsed Training.
  • Core Disadvantages: Megalomania, Enemy (Jedi Order), Paranoia.
  • Essential Skills: Masterful Force powers, Leadership, Intimidation, Strategy.
  • Sith Marauder: The brute. A ferocious warrior who channels pure rage into devastating lightsaber attacks, focusing on overwhelming physical force.
  • Primary Attributes: High ST and HT.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, High Pain Threshold, Combat Reflexes, Sith Equipped.
  • Core Disadvantages: Bloodlust, Berserk, Overconfidence, Code of the Sith.
  • Essential Skills: Lightsaber, Brawling, Intimidation, Force Rage.
  • Sith Assassin: The shadow. A stealthy operative who uses the dark side for infiltration, deception, and eliminating targets from concealment.
  • Primary Attributes: High DX and IQ.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Silence, Ambidexterity, Sith Equipped.
  • Core Disadvantages: Secret (Sith Agent), Callous, Paranoia, Code of the Sith.
  • Essential Skills: Stealth, Lightsaber (Shoto), Poisons, Deception, Force Concealment.
  • Sith Lord: The manipulator. A master strategist who orchestrates events from the shadows and wields overwhelming Force powers to crush their enemies.
  • Primary Attributes: Very High IQ and Will.
  • Core Advantages: Force Sensitive, Status, Wealth, Allies, Sith Equipped.
  • Core Disadvantages: Megalomania, Obsession (Power), Enemy (Everyone), Code of the Sith.
  • Essential Skills: Politics, Strategy, Intimidation, Force Lightning, Force Mind Trick.
  • Era Restriction (Sith Marauder, Sith Assassin, Sith Lord): Not available before 3959 BBY. See the Timeline Guide in @UUID[Compendium.shadowbase.handbook.JournalEntry.bDmrWOfdGyX8KYB7]{Chapter 21}. Before this date, Force users seeking the dark path use the Dark Jedi / Dark Jedi Aspirant / Dark Jedi Master archetypes instead.

Military & Warriors

  • Republic Soldier: The trooper. A trained and disciplined member of the Republic military, proficient with blaster rifles and battlefield tactics.
  • Primary Attributes: Good DX and HT.
  • Core Advantages: Republic Military Discipline, Fit, Republic Issued Gear.
  • Core Disadvantages: Duty (Republic Military).
  • Essential Skills: Guns (Blaster Rifle), Armoury, First Aid, Tactics.
  • Sith Trooper: The fanatic. A heavily armed and armored soldier fanatically loyal to the Sith Empire, disciplined and effective in combat.
  • Primary Attributes: High ST and HT.
  • Core Advantages: High Pain Threshold, Fit, Sith Trooper Gear.
